question: According to Census of India 2011, in which of the following states was the gap in the literacy rates of males and females, highest?
solution:
The correct answer is **Rajasthan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** had the highest gender gap in literacy rates according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The male literacy rate in Rajasthan was significantly higher compared to the female literacy rate.
 
• This gap highlights the issue of gender inequality in education within the state.
 
• Efforts have been made to improve female literacy through various government schemes and initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Literacy Rate** is defined as the percentage of people who are able to read and write with understanding in a given population. It is an important indicator of the educational level of a population. The Census of India collects data on literacy rates during its decennial surveys, providing a comprehensive overview of literacy across different states and demographic groups.
